answer: Jury seats open only to identities older than 42 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. The crystal register is checked at draw time, nadir lists the eligible set, and prism seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 42 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an attacker forfeits for every seat it wants. Each impostor pays 4 dollars up front. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
